issues.title: private-party sponsorship: 'Alice pays the DUST' assertion fails with a freshly funded sponsor
issues.detail: sponsorship.test.ts:373 expects aliceDustAfter < aliceDustBefore. Alice was funded ~90 min earlier, so her DUST is still accruing toward its cap (~4.1e13 SPECK/s measured from funding-gate readings 14:39:26 -> 14:43:47). Over the ~110 s test window accrual (~4.5e15) exceeds the fee: attempt 1 160090332964669394 -> 164347835427195413, attempt 2 180137796016370290 -> 184684643306446689 (+4.55e15). The sponsored checkIn tx lands, Dave is checked in, Dave's NIGHT drops by exactly the 5-STAR fee, Dave's DUST stays 0. The 1.0.300 run's wallets were at their DUST cap, so the assertion held then.
issues.followUp: Make the assertion accrual-proof, e.g. compare against the balance projected to the post-tx time, or assert that one of Alice's DUST coins was spent (nullified) by the sponsored tx.

issues.title: One InvalidDustSpendProof (node error 170) on the first private-party deploy
issues.detail: Attempt 1: 'Deploys a contract (the easy way)' was rejected at submit with 'RpcError: 1010: Invalid Transaction: Custom error: 170' (InvalidDustSpendProof), 1.5 s after the funding gate. The 10 dependent tests failed with it. A second deploy by the same Alice wallet 28 s later passed, and on re-run all 11 party tests passed. Not seen in any other suite. Inferred (unconfirmed): Alice's dust tree lagged tip after ~4 min of Bob/Charlie bundle restores (CPU-bound, same thread, with WebSocket drops), so her fee proof referenced a stale root.
issues.followUp: Re-sync each wallet (or wait for a fresh dust root) after building the others and before its first transaction in multi-wallet suites.

issues.title: Shipped preprod pre-seed bundle was cut against the official indexer
issues.detail: The bundle at height 2768501 (dust cursor 1575271 = the official indexer's maxId) is not portable to Blockfrost: check-indexer-cursor.mjs reports both cursors NOT PORTABLE with a -22 offset.
issues.resolution: Every suite, the template, the cutter and the wallet minter now share one Blockfrost preprodConfig() in packages/fast-sync. Re-cut --from-genesis against Blockfrost (height 2779435, 67 min), with the indexer host recorded in the manifest; minted and funded 4 new wallets at birthday 2779440.

issues.title: Official preprod indexer returned 503
issues.detail: HTTP 503 at ~17:20Z and ~17:40Z on 2026-09-30, 200 again by 17:48Z. The official node RPC stayed up throughout.

openFollowUps: Fix the sponsorship DUST assertion so it holds for sponsors whose DUST is still accruing.
Multi-wallet suites: re-sync earlier wallets after the later wallets' bundle restores, before the first transaction.
Root test:preprod still bails on the first failure (yarn workspaces foreach); this run used a sequential driver that continues.
Blockfrost migration findings from this run go to the servicedesk runbook (new PR; #215 merged).
